definition: a young woman who is not married
description: At a summer village fête in a meadow near an old stone church tower, with bunting strung overhead, an older woman places a crown of white daisies and blue cornflowers on the long fair hair of a young woman in a navy dress standing at a wooden table covered in wildflowers and folded floral cloths. Then the young woman turns and walks away towards three other young women in flowery summer dresses, who sit holding their own flower crowns, while the older woman picks up more flowers. Villagers stand in the warm sun.

taps.phrase: to lean on the wooden table
to stroll away from the table
